meta.name: Puzzle 05 — Guard the Beehive
meta.description: SOLO PUZZLE. A Beehive (stable still life) sits in the center. A Glider is incoming from the NW and will destroy it. Goal: stop the glider in 1 move so the Beehive stays intact. Teaches defensive placement + that still lifes need protection from spaceships.
meta.rules: Solo mode. Prompt: 'Keep the Beehive alive. Block the incoming glider in 1 move.' Win check: Beehive cells (X) still present at end, glider fully neutralized.
questions: Does 'stop a threat before it arrives' read as a strategic puzzle?
Is the glider's trajectory visibly readable so the player can aim?
Does ghost preview of 'beehive still alive after advance' feel like the right tell?

moves.note: Player drops a Block in the glider's path. The glider will crash into it before reaching the beehive.
Observe aftermath — beehive should still be intact.
